stories.headline: Andorra and San Marino sign association agreements with the EU
stories.summary: Andorra and San Marino have each signed an association agreement with the European Union. The agreement organises the two small states' participation in the single market. It was signed on 19 October 2026, after the Council of the EU authorised the signing in July.

stories.headline: Equatorial Guinea widens a malaria programme to the mainland
stories.summary: Equatorial Guinea has announced that it will expand its programme against malaria to the mainland and to Annobón. The programme has already heavily reduced malaria cases on Bioko Island.

stories.headline: A touch from a healthy neighbour revives dying coral
stories.summary: Coral that had turned white and was close to dying regained its health within seven weeks when it was left in contact with a healthy fragment of the same animal. In the laboratory experiment each pair held one healthy fragment and one bleached fragment from the same coral animal. The bleached fragments that were kept apart died.
